If it got past the snapshot, the box went back to the previous version.
apply.running: An update or a rollback is already running. Wait until the box has restarted.

channel.invalid: The update channel's file cannot be read; the box keeps what it knew.
channel.mismatch: The update source answers with the {channel} channel, but this box follows {expected}.
channel.sequence_old: The update source sent an older channel file ({sequence}) than this box saw before ({known}). It was ignored.
channel.signature_invalid: The update channel's signature is {reason, select, missing {missing} malformed {damaged} untrusted {from a key this box does not trust} other {wrong}}. The box ignores it.

download.mismatch: The downloaded update file is not the one the channel names. Nothing was installed; try again later.

file.architecture: This update file is for {architecture}, but this box is {box}.
file.channel: This is a {channel} update file, but this box follows the {boxChannel} channel. Switch the channel in Settings > Updates to install it.
file.hash_mismatch: The update file is damaged: {path} does not match its manifest. Download it again.
file.invalid: This is not a Pithyx update file, or it is damaged.
file.minimum: This update needs at least Pithyx {minimum}; this box has {installed}. Install a version in between first.
file.missing_entry: The update file is incomplete: {path} is missing.
file.not_found: There is no uploaded update file any more. Upload it again.
file.older: This update file brings Pithyx {version}, but the box already has {installed}. An older version only comes back through a rollback.
file.signature_invalid: The update file's signature is {reason, select, missing {missing} malformed {damaged} untrusted {from a key this box does not trust} other {wrong}}. Nothing was changed.
file.too_large: The update file is larger than {limit, number} bytes.
file.unexpected_entry: The update file contains {path}, which its manifest does not name. Nothing was changed.

none.available: There is no newer version on this channel.

rollback.unconfirmed: The typed version does not match {version}. Nothing was changed.

snapshot.not_found: The snapshot {snapshot} does not exist any more.

source.invalid: The update source file does not pass its check ({reason, select, json {not JSON, or larger than 64 KB} url {the URL must use https and contain '{channel}'} schema {a field is missing, unknown or malformed, or a public key is not 32 bytes} duplicate_key {a key id appears twice} other {{reason}}}).
source.unreachable: The update source cannot be reached ({reason, select, network {no connection} timeout {no answer in time} status {answer {status}} missing {the channel has no release yet} scheme {only https is allowed} other {{reason}}}). The box tries again tomorrow; you can upload an update file instead.

space.insufficient: The system disk has {free, number} bytes free, but the update needs {needed, number}.

system.unsupported: Updates apply only to a box installed with the Pithyx installer. This machine is laid out differently ({reason}).
